name: UCI-HAR
dataset: UCI Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones
channel_description: 3 accelerometer (x, y, z) + 3 gyroscope (x, y, z) + 3 total acceleration (x, y, z)

protocol.note: Data is pre-segmented by dataset authors. No custom windowing needed.

description: 30 subjects performed 6 activities (Walking, Walking Upstairs, Walking Downstairs, Sitting, Standing, Laying) with a waist-mounted smartphone recording accelerometer and gyroscope data at 50Hz. The dataset is pre-segmented into 2.56 second windows with 50% overlap. The task is to classify each window into one of the 6 activities. Train on subjects 1 to 21. Test on subjects 22 to 30. Subject 14 is a known anomaly and must remain in the training set.
